$comment: Anvaya University's authored admissions content: what the counsellor answers from. Fictional. Amounts in INR, dates DD MMM YYYY.

process.title: Choose a programme
process.text: Check eligibility, fees and the next intake on the programme page.

process.title: Apply online
process.text: Fill the five-step application and pay the application fee: ₹1,500 for campus programmes, ₹500 for online programmes and certificates.

process.title: Selection
process.text: Take AUSAT or send an accepted score, then an interview or studio test where the programme has one.

process.title: Offer
process.text: Offers go out within 21 days of the selection step, by email and on the applicant portal.

process.title: Confirm your seat
process.text: Pay ₹75,000 within 15 days of the offer to confirm the seat. It is adjusted against the first-year fee.

ausat.name: AUSAT 2027 (Anvaya University Scholastic Aptitude Test)
ausat.format: Online, proctored from home; 2 hours; 120 questions on English, quantitative aptitude, logical reasoning and a short domain section. No negative marking.
ausat.note: Registration is included in the application fee. You may sit up to two phases; the better score counts.

fees.what_is_included: The yearly fee covers tuition, labs, library, exams and the student activity fund. Hostel and mess are separate.
fees.seat_confirmation: ₹75,000 within 15 days of the offer, adjusted against the first-year fee.
fees.instalments: The yearly fee is paid in two equal instalments, by 15 July and by 15 January. Online programmes are paid per semester.
fees.zero_interest_plan: Anvaya's own zero-interest plan splits a year's fee into six monthly instalments, for a ₹2,000 processing charge per year.
fees.refund: Withdraw before the programme starts and everything paid is refunded except ₹10,000 processing. After the programme starts, the current semester's fee is not refunded; the caution deposit always is.
fees.payment_methods: UPI, debit or credit card, net banking, or a demand draft in favour of Anvaya University, payable at Pune.

hostel.summary: Separate hostel blocks for women and men on both campuses, with 24-hour security and resident wardens. The yearly charge includes four meals a day, Wi-Fi, housekeeping and laundry twice a week.
hostel.allotment: Rooms are allotted in order of seat confirmation. First-year students who request a room by 30 Jun 2027 are guaranteed one; the room type is subject to availability.
hostel.rules: First-year in-time is 10:30 pm. Visitors meet residents in the lounge. Guardians can stay in the campus guest house at ₹1,800 a night.

loans.summary: Anvaya's education-loan desk helps families apply to partner banks and finance companies. Anvaya issues the admission letter and the fee-structure letter lenders ask for, within two working days of a request.
loans.covers: Lenders usually finance the full programme fee, and hostel and mess when you ask for them on the fee-structure letter.
loans.timeline: Most families get a lender's decision within 7 to 10 working days of handing in complete documents.
loans.who_decides: The interest rate, collateral and co-applicant terms are the lender's, not Anvaya's. The loan desk can tell you which documents each lender needs.

scholarship_rules: One scholarship per student: the highest one you qualify for is applied.
The exception is Women in STEM, which adds to one other scholarship; together they are capped at 75% of tuition.
Scholarships reduce tuition only, never hostel or mess.
Choose the scholarship on step 3 of the application; it is confirmed with the offer.
To keep it in later years: a CGPA of 7.5 or above and no disciplinary action, reviewed every year.

documents.label: Class 12 marksheet (or admit card if appearing)
Entrance scorecard (JEE Main, CAT, CLAT, NEET-UG or other)

faqs.q: Can I apply while I'm still in Class 12?
faqs.a: Yes. Apply with your Class 10 marks and your Class 12 admit card; your Class 12 marks are checked when results are out, and the offer is provisional until then.

faqs.q: Can I apply to more than one programme?
faqs.a: Yes, up to three programmes on one application and one application fee. AUSAT counts for all of them.

faqs.q: Is there a management or NRI quota?
faqs.a: No. Every seat is filled on the published selection process.

faqs.q: Can my parents attend the counselling session?
faqs.a: Yes. Families are welcome on calls and at campus visits, which run every Saturday at 11 am on both campuses.

faqs.q: What if I miss a round deadline?
faqs.a: Apply in the next round. Round 3 runs only if seats remain, so earlier rounds have more seats and more scholarship budget.

faqs.q: Are online degrees the same as campus degrees?
faqs.a: Yes. The degree certificate does not say online; the faculty and exams are the same.
